title.narrative: Output 7.2. Increased capacity of Member States to ensure safe and healthy working conditions

description.narrative: The tripartite constituents, led by the Ministry of Labour in Charge of Formalisation and Social Protection of Djibouti, adopted a National OSH policy and a national OSH programme in September 2023. The National OSH Policy was developed based on the national OSH profile and consultations with tripartite partners. ILO provided technical support on the elaboration of the Djibouti national OSH profile which was validated by the tripartite constituents. The National OSH Profile is an inventory of all the tools and resources available in a country to implement and manage occupational risks. It has been developed to provide the data needed to establish national priorities for action aimed at progressively and continuously improving the national OSH system. The OSH profile enabled the Ministry of Labour to discuss with the social partners the first OSH policy based on a culture of prevention and focused on national OSH priorities and to define a national OSH programme.
